description: Turn one e-invoice (UBL 2.1 Invoice or CreditNote, Peppol BIS Billing 3.0, XRechnung UBL or CII, or a ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF with the XML inside) into a clean A4 PDF: seller and buyer with VAT ID and e-invoice address, every line, VAT breakdown, totals, IBAN and payment terms. Labels in English, German, French or Dutch (auto = seller's country). Returns the PDF as base64 plus the parsed header, totals and arithmetic checks. DOCTYPE / ENTITY refused. Deterministic, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.005/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/ubl-invoice-to-pdf.

lang.description: Language of the PDF labels; auto = from the seller's country (DE/AT/CH -> de, FR -> fr, NL/BE -> nl, else en)

xml.description: The e-invoice as XML text (empty = built-in XRechnung UBL sample with 2 VAT rates)

name: ubl_invoice_to_pdf
title: UBL / XRechnung / Peppol invoice to PDF API - printable A4 PDF with totals and arithmetic checks
